channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Andray Blatche | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Andray Blatche from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Jimmy Alapag on Andray Blatche
item.description:
“We were on the road together for about a month. That helped a lot to build that camaraderie and get to know Andray better. He was committed to the program from Day 1 and I think it showed.”

Jimmy Alapag on Andray Blatche, Sep 12, 2014. Source: HoopsHype.

item.title: Chot Reyes on Andray Blatche
item.description:
Both Gilas Pilipinas head coach Chot Reyes and current naturalized big man Marcus Douthit believes it will be a doable task since both have talked to Blatche, who plays for the National Basketball Association's Brooklyn Nets.

“In our first conversation (with Blatche) I asked him if he really wants to do this,”

Chot Reyes on Andray Blatche, Apr 1, 2014. Source: Rappler.

item.title: Billy King on Andray Blatche
item.description:
Jared Zwerling:GM Billy King on Blatche returning:

“Andray was a vital member of our team last season. He provides valuable frontcourt depth.”

Billy King on Andray Blatche, Jul 11, 2013. Source: Twitter @JaredZwerling.

item.title: Randy Wittman on Andray Blatche
item.description:
Michael Lee:Wittman on Blatche:

“Not going to get into that. We did everything we could to help him as we will with every player that ever comes here.”

Randy Wittman on Andray Blatche, Nov 27, 2012. Source: Twitter @MrMichaelLee.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Andray Blatche
item.description:
“I look at the Washington [Wizards] model, where they played Andray Blatche and those guys, and what did it teach them? That they're going to play them anyway?”

Doc Rivers on Andray Blatche, Jun 12, 2012. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Maurice Evans on Andray Blatche
item.description:
Michael Lee:Mo Evans on Andray Blatche:

“Those boos aren’t just for him. They are for the team in general. We’re consistently underperforming.”

Maurice Evans on Andray Blatche, Mar 6, 2012. Source: Twitter.
